full_text_zh:
[P1] 青蛙和绿色的伞
qīng wā hé lǜ sè de sǎn

[P2] xiǎoqing wā gǎn dào hěn chénmèn
小青蛙感到很沉闷。
tā zài lǜ cǎo cóng zhōng sàn bù  jiù xiàng rén men zài
他在绿草丛中散步,就像人们在
sēn lín lǐ sàn bù yí yàng
森林里散步一样。

nǐ hǎo a  wú guī xiān sheng  xiǎoqing wā kàn
“你好啊,乌龟先生。”小青蛙看
jiàn yī zhī wú guī  nǐ jí mángmáng de yào dào nǎ
见一只乌龟,“你急急忙忙的要到哪
er qù  yǎo nǐ bèi shang dōu lěi chū hàn lái le
儿去?瞧你背上都累出汗来了。”
bù  wǒ bèi shang shì bú huì chū hàn de  dāng wǒ
“不,我背上是不会出汗的。当我
bèi shang yǒu shuǐ zhū de shí hou  shì yào xià yǔ le  kōng
背上有水珠的时候,是要下雨了,空
qì tài cháo shī le  wú guī chuān le yī kǒu qì shuō
气太潮湿了。”乌龟喘了一口气说,
“nǐ bú jué de mēn ma  bào yǔ jiù yào lái le!
你不见得闷吗?暴雨就要来了!”

[P3] 小青蛙一听，来不及向乌龟道别，“扑通”一下跳进了长满荷叶的水池……
随着一阵雷声，暴雨倾注下来了。
正要出门的小兔看见大雨发愁了，但他推开门就发现一片大荷叶。这不是一把挺好的伞吗？他打着伞收白菜去了。
正要出门的小松鼠看见大雨发愁了，但他看到树下有一片大荷叶。这不是一把挺好的伞吗？他打着伞去采蘑菇了。

[P4] 正要出门的蜥蜴看见大雨发愁了，但他看到窗下有一片大荷叶。这不是一把挺好的伞吗？他打着伞去看望生病的伙伴了。

正走在半路上的乌龟看见大雨发愁了，但他看到路边石头上放着一片刚摘下的大荷叶。这不是一把挺好的伞吗？他打起伞继续赶路……

傍晚，天慢慢晴了，偶尔飘来几点雨滴。小兔、松鼠、蜥蜴、乌龟办完事回家了，他们在一根白树干做成的桥上相遇了。大家打着荷叶伞，彼此看着，都感到很奇怪。

只有乌龟知道，这伞是谁送的。

[P5] 远处，河岸下，青蛙正跷着二郎腿，望着桥上的伙伴们。只见蓝莹莹的河水上，架着白云般的桥，桥上走着灰色的兔子、棕色的松鼠、青色的蜥蜴和黑色的乌龟。他们都打着一把碧绿碧绿的荷叶伞。
小青蛙自言自语道：“多么美丽的图画，多么可爱的伙伴哪！”
full_text_en:
[P1] Frog and the Green Umbrella
qīng wā hé lǜ sè de sǎn

[P2] xiǎoqing wā gǎn dào hěn chénmèn
The little frog felt very gloomy.
tā zài lǜ cǎo cóng zhōng sàn bù  jiù xiàng rén men zài
He was walking through the green grass, just like people
sēn lín lǐ sàn bù yí yàng
walking in the forest.

nǐ hǎo a  wú guī xiān sheng  xiǎoqing wā kàn
"Hello, Mr. Turtle," said the little frog, seeing a turtle.
jiàn yī zhī wú guī  nǐ jí mángmáng de yào dào nǎ
"Where are you in such a hurry? Look, your back is all sweaty!"
er qù  yǎo nǐ bèi shang dōu lěi chū hàn lái le

bù  wǒ bèi shang shì bú huì chū hàn de  dāng wǒ
"No, my back doesn't sweat. When I have water droplets on my back, it means it's going to rain. The air is too damp," the turtle panted.
bèi shang yǒu shuǐ zhū de shí hou  shì yào xià yǔ le  kōng
qì tài cháo shī le  wú guī chuān le yī kǒu qì shuō
"Don't you feel stuffy? The heavy rain is coming!"

[P3] The little frog, upon hearing this, didn't have time to say goodbye to the turtle, and "plop" jumped into the pond full of lotus leaves...
With a thunderclap, the heavy rain poured down.
The little rabbit, just about to go out, was worried by the heavy rain, but when he opened the door, he found a big lotus leaf. Isn't this a pretty good umbrella? He went to harvest cabbages with it.
The little squirrel, just about to go out, was worried by the heavy rain, but he saw a big lotus leaf under the tree. Isn't this a pretty good umbrella? He went to pick mushrooms with it.

[P4] The lizard, who was about to go out, felt worried when he saw the heavy rain. But then he saw a big lotus leaf under the window. Isn't this a pretty good umbrella? He took it and went to visit his sick friend.

The turtle, walking halfway, also felt worried about the rain. But he saw a freshly picked big lotus leaf on a stone by the roadside. Isn't this a pretty good umbrella? He took it and continued on his way...

In the evening, the sky slowly cleared, with only a few drops of rain falling occasionally. The rabbit, squirrel, lizard, and turtle had finished their errands and were heading home. They met on a bridge made of a white tree trunk. Everyone was holding a lotus leaf umbrella, looking at each other and feeling very strange.

Only the turtle knew who had sent this umbrella.

[P5] In the distance, under the riverbank, the frog was stretching out its legs, looking at its companions on the bridge. He saw the blue, glistening river, with a bridge as white as clouds. On the bridge walked a gray rabbit, a brown squirrel, a green lizard, and a black turtle. They were all holding bright green lotus-leaf umbrellas.
The little frog said to himself, “What a beautiful picture, what lovely companions!”
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《青蛙和绿色的伞》及其拼音。
[P2] 小青蛙在绿草丛中散步时感到沉闷，遇到一只急匆匆的乌龟。乌龟解释自己背上冒水珠是因为空气潮湿，预示着暴雨即将来临。
[P3] 暴雨突然降临，小青蛙跳进荷叶池避雨，小兔和小松鼠则分别用大荷叶当伞，去收白菜和采蘑菇。
[P4] 暴雨过后，蜥蜴和乌龟分别用荷叶当伞去办事，傍晚时分，小兔、松鼠、蜥蜴和乌龟在桥上相遇，大家都打着荷叶伞，感到奇怪，只有乌龟知道伞的来源。
[P5] 暴雨过后，小青蛙在河岸下看到桥上的伙伴们——兔子、松鼠、蜥蜴和乌龟——都打着荷叶伞，他自言自语地赞叹这美丽的景象。
